desc: 大眼软胶小螃蟹，多色可选，方便宝宝抓握
leaf: 萌趣卡通小螃蟹安抚抓握软胶玩具（大眼橙钳青绿壳，白腹灰绿分节腿）
name: 趣萌卡通小螃蟹安抚抓握玩具款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼认出是一只大眼萌蟹而不是普通塑料玩具，靠干净剪影拿点击并满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏用一行大字加一排四个线性图标位，一秒给出第一购买理由。
shots.textZone: clear headline field across the top third, one support line directly beneath it, one row of four icon blobs under the support line

shots.intent: 用左暗右亮的同景对比放大「玩具太硬、抓不住、不爱玩」的日常摩擦，把软胶抓握的价值垫出来。
shots.textZone: one short top-centre label over a flat #FFFFFF strip, two small contrast chips at the panel bottoms

shots.intent: 把小螃蟹放进家里的爬行垫场景，用低角度与真实尺度参照让家长代入宝宝坐在地上玩的画面。
shots.textZone: one short bottom band label over the mat area

shots.intent: 微距交代钳面压纹与壳体合模线，把软弹手感与做工本身交给画面而不是话术。
shots.textZone: one small rounded accent badge in the lower corner holding a single short label

shots.intent: 用正俯视一次交代眼珠眼圈、蟹嘴线与白腹壳体三处可见结构，回答「这是什么做的、怎么抓」。
shots.textZone: heading across the top of the card and three short numbered callout labels in the space beside the toy

shots.intent: 双视图加尺寸标注与三行规格位，把「多大、好不好抓」的疑虑一次消掉，数值全部留给卖家自填。
shots.textZone: two dimension brackets with values, one three-row spec block at the lower left

shots.intent: 把卖家在售的两款配色等距等光排开，替买家一次完成选色决策。
shots.textZone: heading at the top centre and one small label chip under each unit

shots.intent: 俯拍到货内容，用可见实物收掉风险，件数与名称交给卖家占位而不编造任何检测结论。
shots.textZone: heading at the top and two short placeholder rows at the side

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口，用低角度萌态加一个明确按钮把看完的犹豫转成加购动作。
shots.textZone: heading and one support line inside the right panel with a rounded CTA button below them

style.backgroundSystem: flat single-colour panels #FBEEE8 and #DDF0E8, each carrying one rounded #FFFFFF product card; decoration limited to flat #FFFFFF puffy cloud shapes, one flat arc band and a few out-of-focus pastel spheres; never a photographic interior or sky gradient behind an infographic
style.direction: cute pastel baby-toy ecommerce, flat candy-pastel panels carrying one rounded product card
style.iconSystem: thin-line rounded sticker icons in #2D2D2D, one per feature row, each sitting on a soft #F7CFC4 blob, plus small numbered circle badges with hairline leader lines; no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seals, no QR codes
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with a bounce fill on the shadow side and a gentle diffuse contact shadow, no hard shadow and no colour cast; the single lifestyle screen uses 4500K warm window light from camera left with every shadow falling consistently to the right
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cute pastel baby-toy ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF base field, #FBEEE8 and #DDF0E8 panel fields, #2D2D2D text ink and one #F2917C accent; neutral tone; one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family with heavy friendly headlines at 28-38pt, 14-18pt support lines and 12pt labels, all rendered copy carried only as short 「」 placeholders; background system of flat single-colour #FBEEE8 and #DDF0E8 panels each carrying one rounded #FFFFFF product card, decoration limited to flat #FFFFFF puffy cloud shapes, one flat arc band and a few out-of-focus pastel spheres, never a photographic interior and never a sky gradient; lighting system of bright even high-key studio light with a soft front-left key, a bounce fill on the shadow side and a gentle diffuse contact shadow, no hard shadow and no colour cast, the single lifestyle screen in 4500K warm window light from camera left; surface system of the rounded #FFFFFF card, one pale mint speckled round display tray and a pale wood #E4D3BC play floor with a #DDF0E8 play mat; icon system of thin-line rounded sticker icons in #2D2D2D on soft #F7CFC4 blobs with small numbered circle badges, no emblems and no certificate artwork; product always rendered true to the reference at a stable front 3/4 slightly-low attitude with a true contact shadow under the spread legs; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no photographic sky gradients, no children or faces or hands, no cluttered layouts.
noDrift: no palette changes and no new accent colours beyond #F2917C
no mixed fonts and no brush, handwritten or cartoon display lettering
no random backgrounds and no stock-photo interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadow
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no children, no faces and no hands in any frame
no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy, no watermark
style.presentationRules: the toy always keeps the same scale and the same front 3/4 slightly-low hero attitude, legs spread and in contact with the surface so a contact shadow is always present, never floating; shell colour #4FC6C4 or #2E9BE8, claw pad #F5A32E or #FFD34D, belly #FFFFFF, leg segments #A5AFA3 and eye rims #7FD3C8 are reproduced exactly from the reference image and never re-mixed; no clipped edges, no child face anywhere
style.surfaceSystem: the rounded #FFFFFF card as the default product surface, one pale mint speckled round display tray as the pedestal, plus a pale wood #E4D3BC indoor play floor and a #DDF0E8 play mat in the lifestyle screen only
style.typography: one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; heavy 28-38pt headlines in #2D2D2D on light panels or #FFFFFF on #F2917C, 14-18pt support lines, 12pt labels; all rendered copy wrapped in 「」 and carried only as short placeholders, per-screen budget under 50 characters
